data.narrative: The learner selected an integration-heavy strategy and verified a six-case Jest/Supertest suite covering the URL Shortener's main user journey and highest-risk failures. A fail-closed TEST_DATABASE_URL guard prevented an unsafe target, and the suite passed three consecutive runs against url_shortener_test with cleanup and unchanged development data. The learner clearly explained test reliability, database isolation, and environment drift as a remaining risk.

dimension_scores.observation: Selected integration-heavy testing for real API and database behavior while emphasizing isolated test state.
dimension_scores.evidence: The learner chose Option B and explained that mocks may miss PostgreSQL, Redis, JWT, and BullMQ integration/configuration problems; the Module 9 suite then exercised real API and PostgreSQL behavior.

dimension_scores.observation: Traced the BREAK failure to the synthetic non-test database target, preserved the guard, and proved repeatability with three full runs.
dimension_scores.evidence: The BREAK artifact records the whitelist rejection before test execution; the FIX artifact records three consecutive 6/6 runs.

dimension_scores.observation: Applied fail-closed database targeting and verified that unsafe configuration cannot reach the application or a real database.
dimension_scores.evidence: api/test/setup-test-db.ts requires TEST_DATABASE_URL and rejects any database name other than url_shortener_test; the BREAK evidence records the guard refusal before NestJS/Prisma initialization.

dimension_scores.observation: Connected deterministic tests and cleanup to safe operations, and identified environment drift with staging and monitoring as mitigations.
dimension_scores.evidence: The learner named environment differences as a remaining risk; the FIX evidence records url_shortener_test identity, cleanup after each run, and unchanged development data.

dimension_scores.observation: Explained the testing strategy, failure cause, isolation rule, proof, and remaining risk clearly and specifically.
dimension_scores.evidence: The learner described the exact guard failure, the expected TEST_DATABASE_URL policy, and the 18/18 repeated-run result in concise terms.

strengths: Connects integration-heavy testing to real dependency behavior and its shared-state costs.
Uses reproducible error evidence and repeated runs to close the loop from BREAK to FIX.
Treats database isolation as a security boundary and verifies cleanup and development-data integrity.
data.recommendation: Add the database-isolated Module 9 E2E suite to pull-request CI and track coverage so future refactors receive the same regression protection.

public_evidence.student_action: Selected integration-heavy testing and verified six end-to-end scenarios across three consecutive runs.
public_evidence.technical_detail: api/test/module-09.e2e-spec.ts covers authenticated link creation, /r/:code redirects, authentication, owner isolation, click retention, and URL validation.
public_evidence.proof: progress/evidence/module-09/fix/determinism-runs.txt records three runs with 6/6 passing each, current_database() as url_shortener_test, and test-data cleanup.
public_evidence.ability: Verifies API behavior and data isolation with integration tests
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows reliable coverage of core URL Shortener behavior and security-sensitive data paths.

public_evidence.student_action: Specified and reviewed a test-database whitelist, then verified that an unsafe simulated target was rejected before application initialization.
public_evidence.technical_detail: api/test/setup-test-db.ts requires an explicit TEST_DATABASE_URL, validates url_shortener_test, and routes Prisma to the test URL.
public_evidence.proof: progress/evidence/module-09/break/unsafe-test-db-target-blocked.txt records exit code 1 at the guard with zero test cases executed and no real database connection attempted.
public_evidence.ability: Protects development and production data through fail-closed test configuration
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates that test safety is enforced before application startup rather than relying on developer caution.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Chose the integration-heavy strategy and verified three deterministic runs against url_shortener_test.
Explained why the synthetic target failed before application initialization and preserved the explicit TEST_DATABASE_URL whitelist.
Identified inconsistent results under unchanged conditions as flakiness and cited shared state, timing, cleanup, and external dependencies as causes.

teaching_approaches.detail: The learner used the URL Shortener's guard failure and repeat-run evidence to explain how isolation supports reliable tests.
